remarks: Updated single-story living in Thousand Oaks for under $900,000! Separate living and family rooms provide flexible space for relaxing and entertaining. The updated kitchen features white cabinetry, quartz countertops, subway-tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and a bright breakfast nook with patio access.
